messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "inform healthcare providers before surgery or procedure"
set: ["inform healthcare providers before surgery or procedure", "sedative given before a procedure", "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure", "tell healthcare team if planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation", "tell healthcare providers about all medicines used", "procedure", "planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation", "inform doctor about planned cataract or glaucoma surgery", "just before or after heart bypass surgery", "medical or dental procedure", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery or dental procedure"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
